newsitem.title: FRANCE: Czech foreign minister sees no wild crown swings.
newsitem.headline: Czech foreign minister sees no wild crown swings.

text.p: Czech Foreign Minister Josef Zieleniec said on Tuesday he did not expect extreme swings in the country's currency after a decision to eliminate the crown's fluctuation band against the central parity of a mark/dollar basket.

"Up to now the central bank has changed the definition of the exchange rate. This will mean the exchange rate between the crown and other currencies will be the result of day-to-day trading," he said on the sidelines of an OECD meeting here.
"I don't think we can expect extreme changes (in the currency)," he said in response to questions from reporters.
